text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that stop control be authorized at two uncontrolled three-way intersections in the Hallbank Terrace area in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate traffic flow.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory stop control for westbound traffic on Hallbank Terrace at Brownspring Road. 2. Designated Tidworth Square, from Pitfield Road to a point 245 metres west, as a through highway.
